question: Choose the correct meaning of Idiom "**To oil the hinges of silence**".

options.text: To bribe someone to remain quiet
To prevent secrets from being exposed
To speak diplomatically in tense moments

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "To bribe someone to remain quiet".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The idiom **"To oil the hinges of silence"** refers to taking action to ensure silence, often by bribing someone to remain quiet. (चुप रहने के लिए किसी को रिश्वत देना)

 

 
• **Example:** The politician tried to oil the hinges of silence by offering money to the reporters who knew about the scandal.

 

 

 
• In this context, the correct interpretation is **"To bribe someone to remain quiet"**, which implies a deliberate act of ensuring silence by offering incentives. (चुप रहने के लिए किसी को रिश्वत देना)

 

 
• **Example:** The company decided to oil the hinges of silence by compensating the whistleblower generously.

 

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: To prevent secrets from being exposed** (गुप्त रहस्यों को उजागर होने से रोकना): This refers to taking measures to ensure that confidential information remains hidden.

 

 
• **Example:** The organization implemented strict policies to prevent secrets from being exposed.

 

 

 
• **Option 3: To gradually break uncomfortable silence** (असहज चुप्पी को धीरे-धीरे तोड़ना): This refers to slowly addressing an awkward silence in a conversation.

 

 
• **Example:** She tried to gradually break the uncomfortable silence by bringing up a neutral topic.

 

 

 
• **Option 4: To speak diplomatically in tense moments** (तनावपूर्ण क्षणों में कूटनीतिक रूप से बोलना): This refers to carefully choosing words to navigate a sensitive or tense situation.

 

 
• **Example:** During the argument, he chose to speak diplomatically in tense moments to avoid escalation.
